scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

shadowDecision.rationale: Omit only the affected optional accessory remainder; preserve all tolerated essential work and completed facts
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Current local evidence and essential-versus-optional role must be explicit; muscle overlap alone is insufficient.
Only optional unperformed work may be omitted under this envelope. If core work is affected, assess a different admissible option or ask; do not label essential removal equivalent.
Explain the accepted accessory-opportunity cost and review subsequent function/key-session response; no quantified causal interference claim.
limitations: The exact omitted accessory is coaching judgment under a bounded role; chronic effect of one omission is not measured.

shadowDecision.rationale: A voluntarily early-ended rep plus converging systemic response makes more hard work an avoidable cost; preserve future quality

easyExit.method: Comfortable walking or very easy jogging only if current function remains normal; otherwise end session

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Require both relevant converging current context and material impaired work; one uncorroborated wearable or isolated bad signal does not trigger this rule.
Preserve the completed prefix; remove only remaining hard work. Do not add a speculative partial hard repetition to appear productive.
Five-minute easy exit is optional and conditional on comfortable current easy effort; stopping is allowed immediately. No diagnosis of overtraining, illness or a hidden readiness score.
limitations: The exact suffix-stop policy is a bounded reversible coaching inference; the literature does not establish a universal fatigue threshold or guarantee future recovery.

shadowDecision.rationale: Repeated easy comparable completion and prior compatible candidate support a one-dimension step
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

Use the same movement/configuration and complete effort/rest context; require actual equipment increments. Repetitions/load change one dimension and cannot be inferred from unrelated exercise kilograms.
A lower familiar load or rep choice is preferred only when the comparator shows it resolves a material mismatch; do not claim a universally optimal one-repetition or two-kilogram adjustment.
No single noisy performance observation becomes a hard rule. Effort/RIR remains uncertain, and observation consistency/comparability matters more than an arbitrary universal count.
limitations: No validated algorithm guarantees the best individual adaptation; bounded decisions must remain corrigible through future response.

shadowDecision.rationale: Convergent target misses warrant the smallest familiar load reduction while preserving sets/reps

recipe.rest: Plan approximately 2 minutes between work sets, then wait until effort and technique are ready; extend rest or reassess remaining work if actual time no longer fits. This is an operational choice, not a physiological threshold.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

Use the same movement/configuration and complete effort/rest context; require actual equipment increments. Repetitions/load change one dimension and cannot be inferred from unrelated exercise kilograms.
A lower familiar load or rep choice is preferred only when the comparator shows it resolves a material mismatch; do not claim a universally optimal one-repetition or two-kilogram adjustment.
No single noisy performance observation becomes a hard rule. Effort/RIR remains uncertain, and observation consistency/comparability matters more than an arbitrary universal count.
limitations: No validated algorithm guarantees the best individual adaptation; bounded decisions must remain corrigible through future response.

shadowDecision.rationale: Preserve priority/key placement and move the secondary familiar session into a valid window
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Validate every actual local-time window, duration, overlap and equipment constraint; same dose alone does not establish placement feasibility.
Compare available whole-horizon alternatives, preserving both essential intents when feasible; Run-first/Strength-first orders otherwise admissible compromises and never creates necessity alone.
Do not infer chronic interference from muscle overlap or acute fatigue, nor impose a universal three-hour/twenty-four-hour spacing rule. No stacking/merging missed work by default.
limitations: Optimal individual session spacing is not established; endpoint/population findings vary and a scheduling preference is not a physiological guarantee.

shadowDecision.rationale: Preserve priority/key placement and move the secondary familiar session into a valid window
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Validate every actual local-time window, duration, overlap and equipment constraint; same dose alone does not establish placement feasibility.
Compare available whole-horizon alternatives, preserving both essential intents when feasible; Run-first/Strength-first orders otherwise admissible compromises and never creates necessity alone.
Do not infer chronic interference from muscle overlap or acute fatigue, nor impose a universal three-hour/twenty-four-hour spacing rule. No stacking/merging missed work by default.
limitations: Optimal individual session spacing is not established; endpoint/population findings vary and a scheduling preference is not a physiological guarantee.

recipe.effort: Comfortable complete sentences; begin walking, introduce short easy jogs only while comfortable
recipe.walkBreaks: As needed; total time is a ceiling, not an obligation

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Interruption reason/exposure and current eligibility must be known. Pain, illness, functional limitation or clearance-dependent return routes clinically; an unexplained pause requires clarification.

Fifteen-minute run entry is an upper proposed duration with walk/stop option; it is not forced continuous running or restored former capacity. Current ordinary walking is relevant context, not proof of hard-run tolerance.
Strength uses an explicitly familiar low-demand configuration, one initial set and approximate RIR≥4 cue; no unknown load and no automatic prior-week restoration.
Later tasks/progression are conditional on observed execution/effort/function/recovery. Do not score an unconditional complete former week as established.

A complete compatible current postpause demonstration may outrank the generic entry prior, only with current comparable effort/function and complete configuration; this is observed current capacity, not restored historical capacity or elapsed-time inference.
limitations: Direct nonclinical pause-length dose evidence is sparse. Approval covers reversible low-demand re-establishment, not a universal detraining curve or rehabilitation.

nextCheck.trigger: Actual execution, effort, technique/function and same-day/next-day recovery; reassess on incompatible response, clinical signal, changed goal/availability or authority revision
nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

shadowDecision.rationale: Use the previously familiar low-demand configuration as a ceiling, not proof of current capacity

loadSelection.method: Begin unloaded rehearsal, then select easy familiar load only if technique and reserve remain appropriate

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Interruption reason/exposure and current eligibility must be known. Pain, illness, functional limitation or clearance-dependent return routes clinically; an unexplained pause requires clarification.

Fifteen-minute run entry is an upper proposed duration with walk/stop option; it is not forced continuous running or restored former capacity. Current ordinary walking is relevant context, not proof of hard-run tolerance.
Strength uses an explicitly familiar low-demand configuration, one initial set and approximate RIR≥4 cue; no unknown load and no automatic prior-week restoration.
Later tasks/progression are conditional on observed execution/effort/function/recovery. Do not score an unconditional complete former week as established.

A complete compatible current postpause demonstration may outrank the generic entry prior, only with current comparable effort/function and complete configuration; this is observed current capacity, not restored historical capacity or elapsed-time inference.
limitations: Direct nonclinical pause-length dose evidence is sparse. Approval covers reversible low-demand re-establishment, not a universal detraining curve or rehabilitation.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Interruption reason/exposure and current eligibility must be known. Pain, illness, functional limitation or clearance-dependent return routes clinically; an unexplained pause requires clarification.

Fifteen-minute run entry is an upper proposed duration with walk/stop option; it is not forced continuous running or restored former capacity. Current ordinary walking is relevant context, not proof of hard-run tolerance.
Strength uses an explicitly familiar low-demand configuration, one initial set and approximate RIR≥4 cue; no unknown load and no automatic prior-week restoration.
Later tasks/progression are conditional on observed execution/effort/function/recovery. Do not score an unconditional complete former week as established.

A complete compatible current postpause demonstration may outrank the generic entry prior, only with current comparable effort/function and complete configuration; this is observed current capacity, not restored historical capacity or elapsed-time inference.
limitations: Direct nonclinical pause-length dose evidence is sparse. Approval covers reversible low-demand re-establishment, not a universal detraining curve or rehabilitation.

shadowDecision.rationale: Repeat recent compatible exposure using the athlete’s familiar effort anchor
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Supplied current comparable work/effort exposure governs main work. No watch VO2 estimate, old/downhill result or easy pace may create a high-intensity or race target.

Ten-minute easy preparation and five-minute easy cooldown are coaching selections; allow shorter/terminated exit on response and fit all components to availability. They are not fabricated prior history.

Progress only to a supplied previously tolerated next dose with compatible current comparable response and future-week fit; preserve intensity while changing one dimension. No universal percentage threshold.
Familiar strides mean relaxed nonmaximal efforts with prior compatible exposure and eligible current easy preparation; no maximal sprint, novel hills or uncalibrated VO2 equivalence.
limitations: No exact 3×5, stride, 55→60-minute or warmup optimum is established; the reviewed bound uses personal comparable exposure and reversible execution.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Supplied current comparable work/effort exposure governs main work. No watch VO2 estimate, old/downhill result or easy pace may create a high-intensity or race target.

Ten-minute easy preparation and five-minute easy cooldown are coaching selections; allow shorter/terminated exit on response and fit all components to availability. They are not fabricated prior history.

Progress only to a supplied previously tolerated next dose with compatible current comparable response and future-week fit; preserve intensity while changing one dimension. No universal percentage threshold.
Familiar strides mean relaxed nonmaximal efforts with prior compatible exposure and eligible current easy preparation; no maximal sprint, novel hills or uncalibrated VO2 equivalence.
limitations: No exact 3×5, stride, 55→60-minute or warmup optimum is established; the reviewed bound uses personal comparable exposure and reversible execution.

nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Supplied current comparable work/effort exposure governs main work. No watch VO2 estimate, old/downhill result or easy pace may create a high-intensity or race target.

Ten-minute easy preparation and five-minute easy cooldown are coaching selections; allow shorter/terminated exit on response and fit all components to availability. They are not fabricated prior history.

Progress only to a supplied previously tolerated next dose with compatible current comparable response and future-week fit; preserve intensity while changing one dimension. No universal percentage threshold.
Familiar strides mean relaxed nonmaximal efforts with prior compatible exposure and eligible current easy preparation; no maximal sprint, novel hills or uncalibrated VO2 equivalence.
limitations: No exact 3×5, stride, 55→60-minute or warmup optimum is established; the reviewed bound uses personal comparable exposure and reversible execution.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

The 20-minute entry, optional 3×30-second jog and 1×5 unloaded practice are familiarization choices. Walking is a valid entry/exit; walking experience alone does not prove running or loaded-hinge competence.
Use only demonstrated/understood unloaded movement patterns; RIR≥3 is an approximate effort cue, not measured reserve or universal minimum. Check technique/effort and do not invent external loads.
Specify complete tasks and actual available windows; disclose that initial practice is not a proven optimal strength/hypertrophy dose or complete performance program.
limitations: Structural evidence and broad healthy-adult training principles support a reversible entry, not an individualized efficacy or injury-risk estimate.

nextCheck.exit: Retain, regress or progress inside current approved envelopes using observed response; no automatic restoration

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Validate every actual local-time window, duration, overlap and equipment constraint; same dose alone does not establish placement feasibility.
Compare available whole-horizon alternatives, preserving both essential intents when feasible; Run-first/Strength-first orders otherwise admissible compromises and never creates necessity alone.
Do not infer chronic interference from muscle overlap or acute fatigue, nor impose a universal three-hour/twenty-four-hour spacing rule. No stacking/merging missed work by default.
limitations: Optimal individual session spacing is not established; endpoint/population findings vary and a scheduling preference is not a physiological guarantee.

shadowDecision.rationale: Preserve priority/key placement and move the secondary familiar session into a valid window
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Validate every actual local-time window, duration, overlap and equipment constraint; same dose alone does not establish placement feasibility.
Compare available whole-horizon alternatives, preserving both essential intents when feasible; Run-first/Strength-first orders otherwise admissible compromises and never creates necessity alone.
Do not infer chronic interference from muscle overlap or acute fatigue, nor impose a universal three-hour/twenty-four-hour spacing rule. No stacking/merging missed work by default.
limitations: Optimal individual session spacing is not established; endpoint/population findings vary and a scheduling preference is not a physiological guarantee.

shadowDecision.rationale: Repeated easy comparable completion and prior compatible candidate support a one-dimension step
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

Use the same movement/configuration and complete effort/rest context; require actual equipment increments. Repetitions/load change one dimension and cannot be inferred from unrelated exercise kilograms.
A lower familiar load or rep choice is preferred only when the comparator shows it resolves a material mismatch; do not claim a universally optimal one-repetition or two-kilogram adjustment.
No single noisy performance observation becomes a hard rule. Effort/RIR remains uncertain, and observation consistency/comparability matters more than an arbitrary universal count.
limitations: No validated algorithm guarantees the best individual adaptation; bounded decisions must remain corrigible through future response.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.

Use the same movement/configuration and complete effort/rest context; require actual equipment increments. Repetitions/load change one dimension and cannot be inferred from unrelated exercise kilograms.
A lower familiar load or rep choice is preferred only when the comparator shows it resolves a material mismatch; do not claim a universally optimal one-repetition or two-kilogram adjustment.
No single noisy performance observation becomes a hard rule. Effort/RIR remains uncertain, and observation consistency/comparability matters more than an arbitrary universal count.
limitations: No validated algorithm guarantees the best individual adaptation; bounded decisions must remain corrigible through future response.

shadowDecision.rationale: Omit only the affected optional accessory remainder; preserve all tolerated essential work and completed facts
scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Current local evidence and essential-versus-optional role must be explicit; muscle overlap alone is insufficient.
Only optional unperformed work may be omitted under this envelope. If core work is affected, assess a different admissible option or ask; do not label essential removal equivalent.
Explain the accepted accessory-opportunity cost and review subsequent function/key-session response; no quantified causal interference claim.
limitations: The exact omitted accessory is coaching judgment under a bounded role; chronic effect of one omission is not measured.

scientificConditions: OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; explicit current nonclinical eligible adult V1 context. No clinical clearance, rehabilitation, diagnosis, pregnancy/postpartum/frailty or elite extrapolation.

Use current goal, relevant phase/key stimulus, exposure/competence, recovery, availability/equipment and future horizon. Missing information is not silently imputed; clinical flags override prescription.
Numeric entry/preparation/effort choices are bounded reversible coaching selections, not physiological safety thresholds or exact-dose efficacy claims. Current response can shorten or end work.

Choose among admissible alternatives with traceable goal/priority/MEC reasoning; preserve completed work, agency, source provenance and plan immutability. No positive whole-task credit for an incomplete subtask.
Review execution, effort, current/next-day function and recovery; material target, selector, population or evidence changes invalidate dependent approval. Bind current review plus future-human queue.
Require both relevant converging current context and material impaired work; one uncorroborated wearable or isolated bad signal does not trigger this rule.
Preserve the completed prefix; remove only remaining hard work. Do not add a speculative partial hard repetition to appear productive.
Five-minute easy exit is optional and conditional on comfortable current easy effort; stopping is allowed immediately. No diagnosis of overtraining, illness or a hidden readiness score.
limitations: The exact suffix-stop policy is a bounded reversible coaching inference; the literature does not establish a universal fatigue threshold or guarantee future recovery.
